title: A pH-responsive dual-network biopolysaccharide hydrogel with enhanced self-healing and controlled drug release properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38353-38363
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05775A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuan Ma, Yunfeng Tang, Jianwei Fan, Tianyu Sun, Xiaoyong Qiu, Luxing Wei, Xiaolai Zhang
A dual network hydrogel based on Schiff base bonding and electrostatic interaction was prepared. The hydrogel is non-toxic, self-healing and injectable. And it has great drug release control, adjusting release rate via SA at different pH levels.
